panels.title: Retention Cohort Heatmap
panels.description: Share of each cohort active on days 0–7 after its first viewing. A dash marks a day that has not yet been observed.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toString(metric_date) AS Cohort,
  maxOrNullIf(value, dimension = '0') AS `Day 0`,
  maxOrNullIf(value, dimension = '1') AS `Day 1`,
  maxOrNullIf(value, dimension = '2') AS `Day 2`,
  maxOrNullIf(value, dimension = '3') AS `Day 3`,
  maxOrNullIf(value, dimension = '4') AS `Day 4`,
  maxOrNullIf(value, dimension = '5') AS `Day 5`,
  maxOrNullIf(value, dimension = '6') AS `Day 6`,
  maxOrNullIf(value, dimension = '7') AS `Day 7`
FROM cinema.daily_metrics
WHERE metric_name = 'retention' AND metric_date BETWEEN toDate32($__fromTime_ms) AND toDate32($__toTime_ms)
GROUP BY metric_date
HAVING `Day 0` IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY metric_date DESC

SELECT toDateTime64(metric_date, 3, 'UTC') AS time, value AS DAU
FROM cinema.daily_metrics
WHERE metric_name = 'dau' AND metric_date BETWEEN toDate32($__fromTime_ms) AND toDate32($__toTime_ms)
ORDER BY time

SELECT toDateTime64(metric_date, 3, 'UTC') AS time, value AS Conversion
FROM cinema.daily_metrics
WHERE metric_name = 'conversion' AND metric_date BETWEEN toDate32($__fromTime_ms) AND toDate32($__toTime_ms)
ORDER BY time
